title: The Port's Been Ready. Cargill's The One Ghosting.

intro_meme.prompt: A cartoon 'FOR LEASE' sign standing alone under a single spotlight on an empty industrial dock, crickets chirping, stand-up comedy stage vibe.

outro_meme.prompt: A cartoon dock worker giving two big thumbs up next to the same 'FOR LEASE' sign, now with a glowing 'READ MORE' arrow pointing at it.

sources.fact: The Pemiscot County Port in Caruthersville has a slackwater harbor, a 5-mile BNSF rail spur, 3-phase power, natural gas, water/sewer, broadband, and 30 acres of ready building sites — all built independent of Cargill's plant.

lines.speaker: kai
lines.text: Nate, you know that port in Caruthersville been fully ready this whole damn time?

screen.prompt: A cartoon empty industrial port with a big glowing neon 'OPEN & READY' sign hanging over it, nobody around.

lines.voice_instructions: Channel Richard Pryor-style stand-up energy: exasperated, escalating, physically reactive delivery — real gasps, real disbelief, voice cracking on the big number. This is two friends losing it together over something absurd, not a news broadcast. Real cursing where the line calls for it, land every word of it like a punchline, not a warning label.
